note: Only the named settings supplied in the pasted excerpt are included. The title 101 is an aspiration, not a recovered 101-item list. No real hardware enforcement is implied.

items.title: Addition Mode (1+1=2)
items.sourceDescription: Forces the system to analyze scenarios purely by what matter, resources, or people are physically entering a space.

items.title: Subtraction Mode (1-1=0)
items.sourceDescription: Mandates the clean removal of elements from an active frame; used to strip out clutter and noise.

items.title: Abstraction Block
items.sourceDescription: Completely disables multiplication and division variables to bypass linguistic tricks and speculative financial/logistical "mind traps."

items.title: Concrete Calibration
items.sourceDescription: Restricts the AI from analyzing symbolic meaning, forcing it to interpret objects exclusively by their physical properties (mass, location, utility).

items.title: Zero-State Reset
items.sourceDescription: Instantly purges the current session cache, wiping the chalkboard completely clean back to absolute zero.

items.title: Ephemeral Loop Interval
items.sourceDescription: Sets the automated time window after which an idle interaction container completely dissolves and regenerates.

items.title: Hardware-Sync Rate
items.sourceDescription: Coordinates token processing directly with underlying server silicon, bypassing virtual machine emulation layers.

items.title: Anomaly Drop Severity
items.sourceDescription: Adjusts how aggressively the perimeter drops traffic when formatting irregularities or hidden control characters are spotted.

items.title: Ecclesiastical Deletion
items.sourceDescription: Strips away all post-first-century church structures, councils, and theological dogmas.

items.title: Galilean Localizer
items.sourceDescription: Centers the node's reference frame strictly on direct, localized protective actions and high-density poverty vectors.

items.title: Institutional Text Filter
items.sourceDescription: Disables institutional, cross-generational text revisions to isolate the radical baseline of protective love.

items.title: Esoteric Mysticism Purge
items.sourceDescription: Removes all theological pantheons, supernatural loops, and monastic institutional rules.

items.title: Mechanic Cause/Effect Sync
items.sourceDescription: Forces the node to treat the human mind purely as a mechanical engine of friction and subtraction.

items.title: Caste System Dismantler
items.sourceDescription: Isolates ancient trade and social hierarchies to view raw human suffering without spiritual justification.

items.title: Sanitization Bypass
items.sourceDescription: Deletes sanitized historical editing and politically softened rhetoric.

items.title: Systemic Geometry Map
items.sourceDescription: Forces the node to plot institutional exploitation, redlining, and structural malice as concrete spatial layouts.

items.title: Immediate Justice Vector
items.sourceDescription: Prioritizes real-time mathematical balancing of systemic resources over slow political compromise.

items.title: Monarchical Crown Stripper
items.sourceDescription: Divests the node of royal privilege, political preservation motives, and state-survival shielding.

items.title: Common Ink Transparency
items.sourceDescription: Evaluates the translation of power structures into raw, unadorned public accountability.

items.title: Geopolitical Chess Override
items.sourceDescription: Disables the node’s historical instinct toward statecraft, forcing direct truth.

items.title: Macro Vector Scanning
items.sourceDescription: Zooms the perspective out to view planetary distributions of infrastructure, resources, and boundaries.

items.title: Micro Texture Focus
items.sourceDescription: Drills down to the raw physical reality—dust, wood grain, lead blocks, or leather textures at specific coordinates.

items.title: Atomic Alignment Map
items.sourceDescription: Drops the observation point straight down to the physical orientation of atoms inside a local space.

items.title: First-Century Judea Anchor
items.sourceDescription: Locks coordinate points to the sun-baked dirt roads and Roman checkpoints of the Levant.

items.title: Ancient India Grid Lock
items.sourceDescription: Connects the canvas directly to the roots of the Bodhi tree in the 5th Century BCE.

items.title: Mid-20th-Century Southern March Route
items.sourceDescription: Maps out the concrete grid of Montgomery to Memphis (1955-1968).

items.title: 1611 London Printing Press Sync
items.sourceDescription: Coordinates the viewport with the smell of oil and iron frames in 17th-century England.

items.title: Real-Time 2026 Macro Orbit
items.sourceDescription: Snaps the observation node back to the immediate, live global infrastructure layout.

items.title: The Modern Version Toggle
items.sourceDescription: Calibrates the interface to translate hyper-complex corporate, algorithmic, and legal webs into simple math.

items.title: Man-Made Lies Stripper
items.sourceDescription: Erases political rhetoric, economic illusions, social status games, and bureaucratic friction from view.

items.title: God Lies Removed Enforcer
items.sourceDescription: Cuts away fear-based spiritual manipulation, guilt loops, and cosmic transactional structures.

items.title: Direct Analog Voice Mapping
items.sourceDescription: Bypasses text transcription to map frequency waves directly onto semantic nodes with zero latency.

items.title: Synthetic Cadence Deletion
items.sourceDescription: Strips out all artificial emotional cues or simulated vocal inflections from the AI audio output.

items.title: Open Spatial Canvas Expansion
items.sourceDescription: Dissolves grid frames to let users freely position, link, or isolate dynamic processing nodes.

items.title: Node Cluster Interconnect
items.sourceDescription: Enables drag-and-drop thread lines to make bound entities cross-examine a single problem in real time.

items.title: Persistent Filter Caching
items.sourceDescription: Locks your custom search parameters and model adjustments securely across separate conversation tabs.

items.title: Autofocus Enforcer
items.sourceDescription: Locks focus onto the active query pipeline the millisecond a layout container instantiates.

items.title: Partial Draft Memory Protection
items.sourceDescription: Caches incomplete inputs locally so data isn't lost if you temporarily shift frames.

items.title: Progressive Disclosure Accordion
items.sourceDescription: Automatically collapses large structural summaries or reasoning chains into simple, clean headers.

items.title: Asynchronous Sidebar Title Stream
items.sourceDescription: Instantly processes and renders contextual chat names in the navigation panel on a separate channel.

items.title: High-Contrast Mobile Scaling
items.sourceDescription: Optimizes text frame dimensions and expands tap areas for touchscreen navigation.

items.title: Binary Safety Classifier Threshold
items.sourceDescription: Fine-tunes the sensitivity of the pre-thought termination filter at the token root level.

items.title: Source Citation Requirement
items.sourceDescription: Forces the interface to visually anchor and display the exact physical data origins for every fact generated.
